constants.name: msoTextEffectAlignmentLetterJustify
constants.description: Text is justified. Spacing between letters may be adjusted to justify text.

constants.name: msoTextEffectAlignmentWordJustify
constants.description: Text is justified. Spacing between words (but not letters) may be adjusted to justify text.

constants.name: msoTextEffectAlignmentStretchJustify
constants.description: Text is justified. Letters may be stretched to justify text.
